entities.name: Vladimir Štimac
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vladimir Štimac is a Serbian former professional basketball player, politician and activist. He also represented the Serbian national team internationally. Standing at 2.11 m, he played at the center position. Štimac was affiliated with the New Democratic Party of Serbia (NDSS) and the National Democratic Alternative (NADA) coalition, now he is leader of his own movement called National Strength.
